name: 16427-batchdecode-kimilinear48b-tp8
model: moonshotai/Kimi-Linear-48B-A3B-Instruct, bf16, ungated. ~49.1B parameters (~98 GB of weights, ~12.3 GB per card at TP8), ~3B active per token. PINNED -- the near-neighbour Moonshot checkpoints are not substitutes for it.
hardware: 8x H100 80GB HBM3, NVLink, one whole a3 node. No router, no external cache tier, no second node.
parallelism: TP=8, PP=1, DP=1, no expert parallelism, no speculative decoding.
architecture: KimiLinearForCausalLM, hybrid: 27 layers, of which 20 are Kimi Delta Attention (linear, recurrent) and 7 are full MLA; hidden_size 2304, sparse MoE with 256 routed experts at top-8 plus one shared expert, vocab 163840. Natively registered at this commit.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=512, warmup the first 25%, bounded at 2048 requests with an 1800 s safety cap. 512 is also the engine's running-batch ceiling for this model, so do not drive above it.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no shared prefix, STREAMING (required -- a non-streaming run reports no ITL at all). Prompts 512 tokens (stdev 128, clamped 256-1024) against 1024 output tokens (stdev 128, clamped 768-1280), `temperature: 0.0`, `ignore_eos: true` so output length is fixed, seed 42.
purpose: A long-form writing assistant streaming thousand-token replies to 512 concurrent users from a 48-billion-parameter model on eight GPUs.
launch:
# ENGINE: sglang at commit 55d112dc79d3097bad7f1c9f7df7efeea3f1f24c, launched from these keys.
#
# FLAT PARSER: `sglang serve` CLI form, one `key: value` per line. A nested block is DROPPED
# silently, and the engine then starts without something this file claims to declare.

model-path: moonshotai/Kimi-Linear-48B-A3B-Instruct
tp-size: 8
trust-remote-code: true
